title: Supervisor run state
description: On-disk state file the supervisor agent reads at the start of every iteration and atomically rewrites before exit. Single source of truth for cross-iteration memory.

version.description: Schema version. Bumped on incompatible state-file changes.

run_id.description: Run identifier, identical to plan.run_id. YYYY-MM-DD.

iteration.description: Iteration counter. Incremented before write each invocation. 0 = uninitialised.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of iteration 1 (run start). Never overwritten.

last_iteration_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the iteration that produced this state.

last_action.description: One-sentence description of what this iteration did. e.g. 'merged PR #87 closes #74' or 'dispatched data-plane subagent for #46'.

issues.description: Map keyed by issue number (as string). One entry per issue listed in plan.issues.

spec.description: Path to spec file relative to repo root, or null if not yet written.

plan.description: Path to per-issue plan file relative to repo root, or null.

branch.description: Branch name carrying the implementation, or null.

worktree.description: Absolute path to the per-branch worktree, or null.

pr.description: PR number once opened, or null.

merged_at.description: ISO timestamp of squash-merge, or null.

follow_up.description: True if this issue was filed mid-run as a follow-up. Affects termination if plan.termination.follow_up_issues_allowed is true.

in_flight_branches.description: Currently open branches owned by the supervisor. Length must be <= plan.caps.concurrent_branch_cap.

blockers.description: Active blockers across the run. Empty array if none. Populated by the agent's failure-handling protocol; cleared when the blocker is resolved.
